[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-k2[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Configurable external mirror filters, its own lumberjack, and [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]two-way bug/PR sync[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A user controls exactly which external bugs and pull requests [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]become beads and Patches, release-please and release-plz PRs are [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]excluded by default, the mirror chops run in their own generously [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]paced lumberjack instead of overrunning the checks lane, a bead [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]linked to a bug tracks that bug's open/closed state, an adopted [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]external Patch tracks its PR's merge state, and the ProjectSpec [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]corruption the mirror has been silently accumulating is fixed and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]repaired.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]external_mirror_refinement.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/external_mirror_refinement.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-k2/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]ProjectSpec description truncation and duplicate-block repair[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]spec_repair[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]spec_repair: fix the two-blank-line record terminator that silently [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drops any Patch whose DESCRIPTION contains a blank run, in both the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Python and Rust parsers plus the block writer, and add the raw-text [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]de-duplication repair that reclaims the archives the external PR mirror [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]has already corrupted.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Configurable bug and pull-request filters[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]filters[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]filters: add external_mirror.issues.filters and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]external_mirror.pull_requests.filters as glob criterion lists with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]"!"-prefixed exclusions, default the PR head-ref criterion to drop [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]release-please and release-plz branches, and migrate exclude_labels and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pr_authors onto the new surface as deprecated aliases.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Dedicated external_mirror lumberjack and lane-independent [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]state[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]lane[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lane: move both mirror chops out of the 300-second checks lane into a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]new external_mirror lumberjack with a 15-minute interval and 5-minute [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]chop timeout, and relocate the PR mirror's cursor and backoff state out [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of the lane directory so no consumer hardcodes a lane name again.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bug state drives mirrored bead status[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]bug_status[dim] · [dim][/dim]after filters[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bug_status: reverse the epic's original note-only decision and close or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reopen a mirrored bead when its tracker issue closes or reopens, guarded[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]so an in-progress, claimed, or parented bead only gets the note it gets [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]today.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adopted external Patches track their pull request[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]patch_status[dim] · [dim][/dim]after spec_repair, filters[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]patch_status: add the refresh action the external PR classifier is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]missing so an already-adopted Patch follows its PR from open to merged [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]or closed and moves from the active ProjectSpec into the archive, across[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the sase-core wire and the Python importer.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bounded per-pass cost for the PR mirror[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]perf[dim] · [dim][/dim]after spec_repair, patch_status[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]perf: stop re-reading and re-parsing the whole active-plus-archive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ProjectSpec index once per mutation in both the sync loop and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]importer, replacing it with one locked batch apply over an incrementally[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]maintained index.[/#D7D7AF]
